title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 244 ]

blocks.text: The water on Earth is always moving in a never-ending journey called the water cycle. The sun heats water in oceans, lakes, and rivers, and some of it turns into water vapor and rises into the air. Plants also release water vapor through their leaves. As the vapor rises, it cools and forms tiny water droplets, which gather to make clouds. When the droplets grow too heavy, they fall back to the ground as rain or snow. This water flows into rivers or soaks into the ground, and sooner or later it returns to the sea, where the cycle begins again.
